name: Emotional Affair
overview: Scripture reveals the deep deceitfulness of the human heart, warning that even inward lust constitutes adultery (Jeremiah 17:9; Matthew 5:27-28). God’s power and authority remind believers to pursue holiness by following Him as His children (Psalms 62:11; Ephesians 5:1). Healing and restoration come through mutual confession and fervent prayer within the community of faith (James 5:16), underscoring the need for accountability to guard against emotional affairs that threaten marital purity.
